newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks end flat ahead of weekend.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks end flat ahead of weekend.

text.p: Pakistani stocks finished slightly higher on Friday as investors squared positions before the Saturday-Sunday weekend, dealers said.
Most investors do not want to take long positions before the budget 1997/98 (July-June), to be announced on June 14, said dealer Ali Asghar at Fortune Securities.

The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index rose 0.17 points, or 0.01 percent, to close at 1,508.15 at 0722 GMT. KARACHI, Pakistan, May 30 (Reuter) - Pakistani stocks finished slightly higher on Friday as investors squared positions before the Saturday-Sunday weekend, dealers said.
The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index rose 0.17 points, or 0.01 percent, to close at 1,508.15 at 0722 GMT.
